description: Build the branch's changed files into the review board — a claude.ai artifact laying each file out as a diff card on a pannable board — publish it, keep its link in a sticky PR comment, and handle the line comments sent to Claude from it as review feedback: fix, push, republish, reply with the commit. Invoke as `/review-board`. Use when the operator says "review board", "доска", "publish the board", "/review-board", or when a comment sent to Claude arrives from the board's artifact.
